checklist.title: Fetch and filter the top-N plugin list
checklist.summary: Call GET /api/package-name-completion-data, keep packages tagged sdk:flutter plus platform:ios or platform:android (SPEC §3.1.1). N is unresolved (open decision 1); implement with N as a parameter, default 100.

checklist.title: Read the is:swiftpm-plugin score tag
checklist.summary: GET /api/packages/<name>/score per plugin, record the tag (SPEC §3.1.2).

checklist.title: Confirm via package archive and flag disagreement
checklist.summary: Look for ios/, macos/ or darwin/<plugin>/Package.swift in the archive; record both signals and flag any plugin where the tag and archive disagree (SPEC §3.1.2, flutter/flutter#187330).

checklist.title: ELF LOAD-segment alignment check
checklist.summary: For every .so in the package archive, read ELF program headers and confirm each LOAD segment's alignment is >= 0x4000 (SPEC §3.1.2).

checklist.title: Parse compileSdk, AGP and NDK from the plugin's Gradle files
checklist.summary: Read android/build.gradle or build.gradle.kts (SPEC §3.1.2). Record as plain facts only, no red/amber/green — grading rule is unresolved (open decision 3).

checklist.title: Assemble one dated JSON snapshot per run
checklist.summary: Per plugin: SwiftPM signals, alignment result, Android facts, version, publish date, downloadCount30Days, likeCount (SPEC §3.1.2-3).

checklist.title: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that commits the snapshot
checklist.summary: Nightly cron; commit the snapshot JSON to this repo so Amplify rebuilds on that commit (SPEC §3.1.3, §2).

checklist.title: Per-plugin row with per-deadline status
checklist.summary: Static Jaspr site, one page per plugin so it's individually searchable (SPEC §2, §3.2).

checklist.title: Evidence and trend display
checklist.summary: Each row shows the evidence behind its colour (file found, or misaligned library + alignment) and trend over time from snapshots, e.g. share of top plugins shipping SwiftPM (SPEC §3.2).

checklist.title: HireFlutter CTA on red rows
checklist.summary: "Blocked by this plugin? A HireFlutter developer can migrate or fork it." (SPEC §2).

checklist.title: AWS Amplify static hosting, rebuild on snapshot commit
checklist.summary: SPEC §2. DNS for ready.hireflutter.dev is unresolved (open decision 5).

checklist.title: Read pubspec.lock and report blockers with evidence
checklist.summary: flutter_ready check: resolve each plugin version against the published data, print per-deadline blockers with evidence; exit non-zero on any blocker; report unlisted or newer-than-last-run plugins as "not checked", never green (SPEC §3.3).

checklist.title: Suggest a replacement package per known blocker
checklist.summary: SPEC §3.3. Source of suggestions is unresolved (open decision 4) — hand-curated list, never generated.

checklist.title: Publish flutter_ready on pub.dev under the hireflutter.dev publisher
checklist.summary: SPEC §2. Name flutter_ready confirmed free 2026-09-26 pending a GitHub check (open decision 2). Publisher move can't be undone, so the publisher must exist first.

checklist.title: Run flutter_ready check as a GitHub Action, fail on blockers
checklist.summary: SPEC §3.4, §6: verify against a sample app repo with a known blocker.

checklist.title: Fixture plugins and recorded pub.dev API responses
checklist.summary: One fixture per readiness state (SwiftPM present, absent, tag/archive disagreeing) plus aligned and misaligned sample .so files; tests never call the network (SPEC §5).

checklist.title: Golden tests of CLI report output
checklist.summary: Run in CI, keep test_output for the build record (SPEC §5).
